high_level_description: stc brand style, a cinematic advertisement of a woman in a modern kitchen holding a purple stc-branded laptop.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern kitchen with light wooden cabinets extending to the ceiling, a white countertop, a gas stove, a window with sheer curtains, and warm cinematic lighting.

Various kitchen items visible on the counter, including a bowl.
The stc brand logo displayed on the purple laptop.
Arabic promotional text in the upper right corner of the frame.
English promotional text at the bottom of the frame.
